info.title: Vero OMS REST API
info.description: REST API documentation for Vero OMS authentication, accounts, orders, history, market data, notifications, referral, diagnostics and static assets.

200.description: Health response. The app treats any 2xx-4xx response as reachable.

bearerAuth.description: JWT returned by Ory /sessions/whoami?tokenize_as=jwt_template_1 and stored by ApiClient.

sessionToken.name: X-Session-Token
sessionToken.description: Ory session token returned by login or recovery flows.

Flow.name: flow
Flow.description: Ory flow id returned by the corresponding create flow endpoint.

Resolution.name: resolution
Resolution.description: Candle resolution in seconds. The app uses 60 for 1 minute and 86400 for daily.

Error.description: Error response. The app reads detail or message when available.

OryFlowError.description: Ory flow validation error. The app reads ui.messages, ui.nodes[].messages, error.message or error.id.

tokenized.description: JWT returned when tokenize_as=jwt_template_1 is requested.

password.description: Mobile app generates a secure random password.

qty.description: Positive is long, negative is short.

orderStatus.description: FIX 5.0 style values used by the app: 0 New, 1 Partially Filled, 2 Filled, 4 Cancelled, 7 Stopped, 8 Rejected. Backend may also return text statuses.

transactionType.description: Examples used by UI: deposit, withdraw, fee, trading_fee, overnight_fee, realized_pnl, pnl, tax, trading_tax, commission, trading_commission, referral_refund, referral_rebate.

unixTime.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds, based on mobile app parsing.

x-centrifugo.description: Centrifugo WebSocket channels used by lib/services/streaming_service.dart. The current client connects anonymously.

channels.name: mkt:{dataType}:{symbol}
channels.description: Generic market data stream. Depth stream often uses mkt:depth:{symbol}-{boardId}.
